category: Tiny adult moments we all pretend are normal
quote: You ever realize your entire personality is just caffeine and anxiety? Buying a kitchen gadget you will use exactly one time ever. Apologizing to your furniture when you accidentally bump into it. Scheduling an appointment just to cancel it because you changed your mind. We are all just making it up as we go, honestly.
